Monica —

Thanks for the flag. I skimmed the matrix and have a few immediate concerns:
- Potential manager bias: two of the impacted ICs report to different managers with different calibration tendencies. We should normalize using a short rubric.
- Timing: avoid sending any formal rating changes until we align on role expectations post-reorg.

Suggested rubric (short):
- Impact (1–5) — evidence/examples only
- Scope shift (yes/no) — does new matrix change role scope?
- Risk to delivery (low/med/high) — mitigation notes

I can draft an anonymized summary if you want; prefer we do the manager-only call first. Tomorrow 10 is fine for me.
